entities.summary: Vikentiy Viacheslavovych Khvoyka was a Czech-born Ukrainian archaeologist. He discovered the Neolithic Trypillia culture of Ukraine and also researched the Scythian, Zarubintsy, Chernyakhov and early Slavic archaeological cultures.
